overview.Module Title: Tv Graphic Design and Special Effects

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module is designed to: Enable students to understand the graphic system for the TV program, especially in a TV studio context, and basic graphic design skills including graphic design software and the idea of a graphic rebranding system. Enable students to understand what a particular graphic item might mean in the context of a TV program. Students will work independently to develop their ideas and produce their graphic system.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate their knowledge of the TV program’s rebranding graphic system. B Preliminarily understand the different effects of different parts of the graphic system in the context of a TV program. C Demonstrate the capabilities of creating graphic work with the specified graphic system, such as 3dmax, After Effect, Vizrt, etc.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and practical workshops.
